description.text: Business administration is a comprehensive discipline that studies "how enterprises can operate efficiently and achieve sustainable development". Its core lies in addressing the issue of "how to integrate enterprise resources (human resources, funds, technology, information, etc.) through means such as planning, organization, leadership, and control to maximize the goals". From the team building of start-up companies, to the global strategic layout of multinational enterprises, to the transformation of enterprises in crisis situations (such as the shift of catering enterprises to takeout services during the pandemic), all fall within its research and practical scope. It is both the "operating system" for the stable operation of enterprises and the "adaptable guide" for responding to market changes.

duration.text: The Business administration at Xi'an Shiyou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2986 USD/per year ￥ 21500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Front page of the passport. 2. Proof of highest educational attainment. If the applicant is a student, a pre-graduation certificate or a certificate of being a student in school issued by the school where he/she is enrolled must be submitted. 3. Academic Transcript. The scanned copy of the transcript should include the grades from the undergraduate or master's study period up to the most recent semester. If it is in a language other than Chinese or English, a Chinese or English translation and notarization must be provided as well. 4. Recommendation Letters. Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, written in either Chinese or English. 5. Study Plan in China. The study plan should be written in either Chinese or English, and it should be no less than 1000 words. 6. Research Achievements: Published papers / Award certificates / Invention patents, etc. can serve as evidence of one's academic achievements and research capabilities. 7. "Foreigner Physical Examination Record Form". It should be filled out in Chinese or English. Download link: http://cie.xsyu.edu.cn/info/1066/2118.htm. 8. Language proficiency certificates, such as HSK certificates, IELTS/TOEFL/ Duolingo test scores, or official English teaching qualification certificates. 9. Certificate of No Criminal Record. If it is in a language other than Chinese or English, a Chinese/English translation and notarization are required. 10. Applicants for the doctoral program should contact the intended supervisor in advance and obtain the "Acceptance Letter from the Supervisor" from the university. The information of doctoral supervisors and the download link for the acceptance letter can be found at: http://cie.xsyu.edu.cn/info/1066/2117.htm.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health. 2. Possess a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualifications, and be under 35 years old. 3. Applicants for courses taught in Chinese must have achieved a score of at least 180 in the New Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK Level 4). 4. Applicants for courses taught in English must have an English proficiency score of 5.5 or above on the IELTS, 69 or above on the TOEFL, or 90 or above on the PTE, or provide proof of English instruction for their highest degree (with the school's official seal).
